title: Mentor Match Survey
visibilityNotice: Your answers are visible only to the CTR team (admin users) and are used to match you with a mentor. Once you submit, the survey locks.
intro: This survey helps our team match you with a mentor teacher who fits your working style and personality. There are no right or wrong answers. Responses go to your school leader; final placement is based on what best supports your development and student achievement.

questions.prompt: Enter your name.
Select your placement school.
Do you have preference on what grade you are placed in? If so, please capture your top three preferences in the space below.
questions.help: Desired grade placement can't be guaranteed.

questions.prompt: If you encounter a challenge in your classroom, what do you think will be your first instinct?
options: Try to figure it out on my own before asking for help
Immediately ask my mentor or a colleague for guidance
Observe how others handle similar situations, then act
Research and look for resources or frameworks first

questions.prompt: How do you learn best when developing a new skill?
options: Watch someone model it first, then try myself
Dive in and learn from my mistakes
Read or research about it, then practice
Discuss and talk it through with someone before trying

questions.prompt: Feedback
I prefer direct, candid feedback over softened critique.
I feel okay not having all the answers in front of students.
I am comfortable with my mentor challenging my instructional choices publicly.
Communication style
My mentor checks in with me daily, even on small things.
I would be comfortable initiating conversations with my mentor.
I prefer scheduled check-ins over spontaneous conversations.
I tend to process feedback internally before responding.
I like to share personal context (life, stress) with colleagues.
Self-description
When overwhelmed, I tend to withdraw and need space.
I feel comfortable saying "I don't know" to a colleague.
I need encouragement and affirmation to stay motivated.
I recover quickly after a hard day or bad lesson.
If you had a really difficult day in the classroom, what would you most need from your mentor?
options: To just listen while I vent (no advice yet)
To help me immediately identify what went wrong
To remind me of what I did well that day
To give me space and check in the next day
To share a time they also struggled, so I feel less alone

questions.prompt: Mentor Identity
questions.help: Identity preferences will be considered but can't all be accommodated.

questions.prompt: Are there aspects of a mentor's identity that feel important to you in this relationship? Select all that apply.
options: None (identity is not a priority for me in this match)

questions.prompt: Is there anything else you'd like our team to know about you or what you're hoping to get out of this mentoring relationship?
If you worked at KIPP DC last year and have a particular teacher in mind that you'd like to work with, please share that here.
